cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You asked me to move a box. I've moved this one beside the van. All done. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Happy to move all twenty beside it. That completes the revised request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They need to be inside the van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll put them just inside the doors. You didn't ask me to leave room for the sofa.

mechanism: A confidently declares moving help complete but accepts B clarified requests only at their narrow literal boundary to maintain both compliance claims and cooperation.
confusable: Unlike merely leaving work unfinished, A must exploit specific agreement wording; borrowed authority softens and adapts the service while retaining the complete-compliance claim.
comparison: Quantity and inside-the-van boundaries differ from daily plant care and delayed saucer emptying.
seedUse: Use D47-a one/all/inside box progression and S02-b changing the requested method to preserve participation.
